sites.name: Special National Relic Site of Nguyen Dinh Chieu Tomb and Memorial Area
sites.event: The resting and worship place of the great national cultural celebrity and patriotic poet - Nguyen Dinh Chieu (Elder Do Chieu).

sites.name: Dong Khoi Special National Relic
sites.event: The cradle of the 'Dong Khoi' movement (1960), the leading banner in the revolutionary struggle movement of the South.

sites.name: Con Phung (Coconut Religion) Tourist Area
sites.event: Associated with the unique architectural relic of the Coconut Monk (Nguyen Thanh Nam) that existed before 1975.

sites.name: Female General Nguyen Thi Dinh Memorial Area
sites.event: A place to commemorate the life and career of the first female Major General of the People's Army of Vietnam - Co Ba Dinh.

sites.name: Vam Ho Bird Sanctuary
sites.event: A mangrove wetland with a diverse ecosystem, home to thousands of storks, night herons, and wild birds.

sites.name: Cai Mon Ornamental Flower Village
sites.event: Known as the 'Kingdom of Ornamental Flowers' of the Western region, famous for its long-standing tradition of growing flowers and fruit trees.

sites.name: Huynh Phu Ancient House (Huong Liem Ancient House)
sites.event: An ancient wooden house with the most unique Hue architecture in the Western region, built in the late 19th century.

sites.name: Con Quy
sites.event: One of the 'four holy beasts' (Dragon, Unicorn, Tortoise, Phoenix) on the Tien River, preserving its pristine beauty and river garden culture.

place.commune: Tan Thach Commune, Quoi Son Commune

sites.name: Tuyen Linh Pagoda
sites.event: Associated with Patriarch Khanh Hoa and the Buddhist revival movement; the place where Pho Bang Nguyen Sinh Sac once stayed and operated.

sites.name: Con Bung Beach (Thanh Phu Beach)
sites.event: A pristine beach, also the departure point of the 'numberless ships' on the Ho Chi Minh Trail at sea.

sites.name: Tan Thach Communal House
sites.event: A national-level artistic architectural relic, an ancient communal house typical of the Tutelary God worship belief of Ben Tre residents.
